steps.name: Sample structure QC: library sizes, PCA, sample distances
caveats: sample_01's library size is ~4x below the cohort median per the data profile; DESeq2's size-factor normalization down-weights but does not remove the effect of low depth -- a low-depth sample carries a wider confidence band in any later test, which is a separate concern from today's QC-only pass
With only 12 samples total, PCA and distance patterns are read as descriptive QC evidence, not as a validated clustering claim
A PCA/UMAP-type embedding shows a picture of variance structure; do not overinterpret gaps between points as a quantified distance -- the sample distance heatmap is the quantified complement
steps.context: Input files: /eval-eight-arms-with-qc-only-n6-1/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv (12000 genes x 12 samples raw integer Salmon-derived counts, first column gene symbol) and /eval-eight-arms-with-qc-only-n6-1/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv (12 samples x condition: AD lesional vs control). Design is unpaired, single batch, 6 vs 6. Data profile flags sample_01 as having a library size about 4x below the median of the cohort. This is a QC-only research question -- no differential expression, no enrichment, no downstream modeling is requested or should be run.
steps.question: For the 12 skin samples (6 atopic dermatitis lesional vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene-level counts), what are the per-sample library sizes, how do samples separate on a PCA of the top variable genes, what do sample-to-sample Euclidean distances show, and is the flagged low-depth sample (sample_01, ~4x below median library size) an outlier that warrants exclusion or a sample to keep with a caveat?

grounding.reason: Matches the knowledge service's sample-structure QC procedure (blind vst, PCA on top-500-variance genes, sample distance heatmap, library sizes) and its explicit rule that a library size several-fold below the median must be kept, inspected on PCA/distances, and reported rather than silently dropped; template tpl-qc-eda@1.0.0.

constraints: Do not run any differential expression test -- this is QC-only per the research question
Use raw integer counts directly with DESeq2; do not pre-normalize or scale the counts before building the DESeqDataSet (normalization is internal to DESeq2 via median-of-ratios size factors)
Apply the vst transformation with blind=TRUE (design-blind) so the QC view does not bias toward the condition split
Keep sample_01 in every step -- do not drop it before or during the QC computation
PCA is computed on the top 500 highest-variance genes on the vst matrix, matching the grounded template default
Report the low-depth sample's exclusion/inclusion as a judgment with a stated reason, not a default action
acceptance_criteria: A table of raw library size (total counts) and number of detected genes (count > 0) per sample, all 12 samples included, sorted so sample_01's rank is visible
A DESeq2 dataset built from the raw counts and metadata with condition as the design factor; size factors reported per sample
A minimal low-count pre-filter applied (keep genes with >=10 counts in at least 6 samples, the smallest group size) before the blind VST
A blind variance-stabilizing transformation (vst(blind=TRUE)) computed on the filtered counts

A PCA plot on the top 500 most-variable genes (by row variance on the vst matrix), points colored by condition (AD lesional vs control) and labeled with sample ID, with percent variance explained on each axis
A sample-to-sample Euclidean distance heatmap computed on the vst matrix, samples ordered/annotated by condition
sample_01 explicitly called out in both the PCA and the distance heatmap output (its coordinates/position and its nearest/farthest neighbors reported numerically, not just visually)

A written verdict on sample_01 that states its library size and detected-gene count relative to the other 11, whether it separates from its condition group on PCA/distances, and an explicit keep-or-exclude recommendation with the stated reason (per the rule that depth alone is not sufficient grounds for exclusion)
All numeric outputs (library sizes, size factors, PCA coordinates, distance matrix) saved as CSV/TSV tables alongside the plots

plan.title: AD lesional vs control skin QC-only sample structure check
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question is strictly a pre-testing QC assessment of the 12-sample AD lesional vs control skin cohort (6 vs 6, unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene-level counts, 12000 genes x 13 columns). No differential expression is requested. The plan runs one grounded QC step: load the raw counts and metadata, apply a minimal low-count pre-filter, build a DESeq2 dataset, compute size factors and library sizes per sample, apply a blind variance-stabilizing transformation, compute a PCA on the top 500 most-variable genes, compute the Euclidean sample-to-sample distance matrix, and render both colored by condition. The flagged sample sample_01 (library size ~4x below median) is kept through the analysis rather than dropped, examined explicitly on the PCA and distance heatmap, and its library size and detected-gene count are reported beside the other 11 samples so a verdict on it is evidence-based rather than a default removal. This follows the knowledge-service procedure for sample structure QC (blind vst, PCA on top-variance genes, sample distance heatmap, library sizes) and its explicit rule that a low-depth sample must be kept, inspected, and reported rather than silently deleted.

steps.method: DESeq2 vst(blind) + PCA + sample distance heatmap + library size barplot
